description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) class for handling ReportingMethod entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, deleting, and counting reporting methods, as well as checking for existing names and fetching their IDs in use.

classes.name: ReportingMethodConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO class for managing ReportingMethod entities, providing CRUD and search functionalities.

methods.name: saveReportingMethod
methods.description: Persists a ReportingMethod entity to the database.

methods.name: getReportingMethodById
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its primary key.

methods.name: getReportingMethodByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ReportingMethod entity by its name.

methods.name: getReportingMethodListPaginator
methods.description: Returns a paginator object for listing ReportingMethods based on search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodCount
methods.description: Returns the count of ReportingMethods matching search filters.

methods.name: getReportingMethodList
methods.description: Returns a list of ReportingMethods matching search filters.

methods.name: deleteReportingMethods
methods.description: Deletes ReportingMethod entities given their IDs.

methods.name: isExistingReportingMethodName
methods.description: Checks if a ReportingMethod with the given name already exists.

methods.name: getReportingMethodIdsInUse
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of ReportingMethods currently in use in ReportTo relationships.
